title: Table of Contents
slide_intent: Make a large identity system navigable so readers can find the rule that answers their immediate question.
strategic_value: Numbered sections can connect Burger King’s strategic story to detailed production guidance.
demonstration: Three columns list sections and subtopics with page numbers; orange headings stand apart from cream entries on brown.
practical_value: Organize a brand book by decisions and preserve direct page references.

content_islands.name: First column
content_islands.spec: Group introduction, voice and logo topics at left.

content_islands.name: Second column
content_islands.spec: Group lockups, color, type, layouts and illustration in the middle.

content_islands.name: Final column
content_islands.spec: Place legal standards, file naming and contacts at right.

reference_purposes.Application: The contents use page numbers and grouped subtopics to locate guidance.
reference_purposes.Expression: Orange section names and cream subordinate entries establish a visible hierarchy.
